## Summary
- expand Android `ClipboardManagerInstrumentedTest` to cover empty clipboard clearing, multi-item first-non-text handling, and an expanded 320 KiB UTF-8 local round trip
- add a MainActivity clipboard boundary contract that prevents non-text `ClipData` coercion before send
- add 2026-09-08 Nubia P0110 no-Host evidence and update Phase 0 clipboard gate docs while keeping `clipboard_android_macos_product_e2e` blocked

## Verification
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityClipboardSystemBoundaryContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardApprovalStateTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardFailClosedTest`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardManagerInstrumentedTest` on Nubia P0110 / pacific / Android 16 / SDK 36: 8 tests, 0 failures
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardConfirmationDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest` on Nubia P0110 / pacific / Android 16 / SDK 36: 2 tests, 0 failures
- `jq empty docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/phase0-stable-release-manifest.json docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-08-after-673-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json`
- `git diff --check`

## Boundaries
- no Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI launch
- no `swift run`
- no Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, or System Settings changes
- no `adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321` setup; the retained reverse snapshot has no `tcp:54321` mapping
- no macOS `NSPasteboard` read/write
- this does not close real Android/macOS clipboard product E2E

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Clipboard handling now respects the first clipboard item and avoids treating later text items as the primary content.
  - Empty and non-text clipboard states are handled more accurately.

- **Tests**
  - Expanded coverage for Unicode text, large clipboard contents, multi-item clips, empty clips, and clipboard round trips.
  - Added confirmation-dialog coverage for large-font readability and send/receive/overwrite-copy behavior.

- **Documentation**
  - Added Android device test results, reproducibility details, checksums, and updated gate-status evidence.
  - Documented current size limitations and that Android/macOS end-to-end coverage remains blocked.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
title: Harden Android clipboard no-Host baseline
